name: 48040 · Marysville, MI
findings: ZIP 48040 (Marysville) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48040 (Marysville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48040 (Marysville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
